tasks.title: First-order response
tasks.statement: The motor time constant is τ = **{tau} ms**. How many milliseconds after a command step does thrust reach **{p} %** of its steady-state value?

tasks.title: Overshoot from damping
tasks.statement: A second-order loop with damping ratio ζ = **{z}**. Find the step overshoot (in percent).

tasks.title: PT1 coefficient
tasks.statement: A PT1 filter with a cutoff frequency of **{fc} Hz** in a **{fs} kHz** loop. Find the coefficient k = T_s/(τ + T_s).
tasks.solution: τ = 1/(2π f_c), T_s = 1/f_s, k = T_s/(τ + T_s). This is how pt1FilterGain() in Betaflight computes it.
